params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $dest=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-runner-bootstrap-retry'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dest -Recurse -Force}; git clone --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $dest; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $dest 'heaven-bridge\install-github-runner.ps1'); $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('INSTALL_EXIT='+$code); if($code -ne 0){exit $code}; Write-Output 'HEAVEN_ACTIONS_RUNNER_BOOTSTRAP_PASS'
